title: The Last Train from Platform 9
description: A chilling midnight encounter at an abandoned train station leads Rajiv onto a journey with no return.

scenes.description: Rajiv walking into an empty, dimly lit old railway station at midnight
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.2) deserted Indian railway station at night, flickering tube lights, wet concrete floor, faint fog, lonely figure of man in dark jacket entering, cinematic horror style:1.3
scenes.negative_prompt: cartoon style, anime style, overly bright, blurry, cheerful colors
scenes.narration: राजीव आधी रात को पुराने स्टेशन में दाखिल हुआ। दूर कहीं अंधेरे में कोई आवाज़ फुसफुसाई — 'क्यों आ गए तुम यहाँ?'
scenes.subtitle: Rajiv stepped into the old station at midnight. Somewhere in the darkness, a whisper asked— 'Why would you come here?'
scenes.motion_prompt: man slowly walking into dimly lit station

scenes.description: Empty platform with broken bench and old vending machine
scenes.visual_prompt: (medium shot:1.2) abandoned platform, rusted bench, broken vending machine, peeling paint on walls, faint greenish light, cinematic horror style:1.3
scenes.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, bright daylight, low resolution
scenes.narration: प्लेटफ़ॉर्म खाली था, बस एक टूटी बेंच और जंग खाया वेंडिंग मशीन खड़ी थी।
scenes.subtitle: The platform was empty — just a broken bench and a rusted vending machine.
scenes.motion_prompt: camera slowly panning across abandoned platform

scenes.description: An ancient black steam train approaching through fog
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.2) old black steam locomotive emerging from dense fog, headlights cutting through mist, eerie green glow in windows, cinematic horror style:1.3
scenes.negative_prompt: modern train, cartoon style, colorful, blurry
scenes.narration: एक काली भाप वाली ट्रेन धुंध चीरती हुई आ रही थी। दूर से वही आवाज़ — 'क्यों सवार हो रहे हो?'
scenes.subtitle: A black steam train emerged through the fog. From afar, the whisper came— 'Why would you get on?'

scenes.description: Inside the train with pale, expressionless passengers
scenes.visual_prompt: (medium shot:1.2) dimly lit old train interior, rows of passengers with pale faces and blank stares, some wearing old-fashioned clothes, cinematic horror style:1.3
scenes.negative_prompt: happy expressions, cartoon, bright daylight, blurry
scenes.narration: अंदर यात्री चुपचाप बैठे थे, उनकी आँखें कहीं भी नहीं टिक रहीं थीं।
scenes.subtitle: Inside, the passengers sat in silence, their eyes fixed on nothing.

scenes.description: Rajiv walking down dim train corridor toward the sound of humming
scenes.visual_prompt: (medium shot:1.2) narrow, dimly lit train corridor, flickering lights, man walking cautiously toward shadowed end, cinematic horror style:1.3
scenes.narration: राजीव धीरे-धीरे उस गुनगुनाहट की ओर बढ़ा जो डिब्बे के आखिरी छोर से आ रही थी।
scenes.subtitle: Rajiv slowly walked toward the humming at the far end of the carriage.
scenes.motion_prompt: man walking through narrow dim corridor

scenes.description: The woman in red saree appears with long hair covering her face
scenes.visual_prompt: (medium shot:1.2) eerie woman in crimson saree, long black hair covering most of face, dim green light from above, cinematic horror style:1.3
scenes.negative_prompt: smiling friendly woman, cartoon, bright colors
scenes.narration: वह वहाँ थी — लाल साड़ी में, लंबे काले बाल उसके चेहरे को ढँके हुए।
scenes.subtitle: She was there — in a crimson saree, her long hair hiding her face.
scenes.motion_prompt: woman standing still with hair covering face

scenes.description: Close-up of her lifting her head, revealing hollow eyes and a smile
scenes.visual_prompt: (close-up:1.2) horror close-up of woman in red saree, hollow dark eyes, unnaturally wide smile, dim green backlight, cinematic horror style:1.3
scenes.narration: उसने सिर उठाया, खोखली आँखें और अजीब सी मुस्कान — 'क्यों हमारे साथ चले आए?'
scenes.subtitle: She looked up, hollow eyes and a strange smile— 'Why would you come with us?'
scenes.motion_prompt: woman slowly raising head to reveal face

scenes.description: The train door slams shut as it speeds into darkness
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.2) train doors slamming shut, motion blur as train speeds into complete darkness, cinematic horror style:1.3
scenes.narration: दरवाज़े बंद हो गए, और ट्रेन अंधेरे में समा गई — 'अब लौटने का रास्ता नहीं है। क्यों चढ़े थे?'
scenes.subtitle: The doors slammed shut, and the train vanished into darkness— 'Now there's no way back. Why would you board?'
